# Every deal. Every rep. Every dollar — accounted for.

Commission operations built for door-to-door sales teams. Forward your carrier statement or drop a CSV and we build the rep statements, handle clawbacks & escrow, and push the whole run to QuickBooks for payroll. Fiber, solar, pest, alarms — if your team walks blocks for a living, this is your HQ.

## Two weeks of sales, one clean paycheck.

Every deal your reps close lands in a clear, per-rep ledger. D2DHQ groups them by payday, applies the right rate card, stacks daily bonuses, subtracts holdbacks — and produces a signed PDF statement reps actually understand. Click a day to add deals and watch payroll recalculate.

## From CSV in to QuickBooks out — one clean pipe.

Send us your deals (CSV upload or statement forward from your carrier). D2DHQ groups them by rep and payday, applies each rep's rate card, stacks daily bonuses and referral credits, subtracts clawbacks on churned accounts, and holds back escrow. Out comes a signed PDF statement for every rep — and the same numbers post straight to QuickBooks for payroll. No re-keying, no reconciliation hell, no 3am surgery the night before payday.

No more "my number doesn't match yours" Slack threads. Your bookkeeper opens QuickBooks and the commission run is already there, coded right.

## Built for the messy middle of D2D payroll.

Rate cards that change per-rep, per-tier. Deals that churn weeks in. Daily bonuses that stack with referrals. Escrow you hold back "just in case." We built for all of it.

### Drop in your deal export. Get grouped payouts out.

Forward us your carrier statement or a CSV. We do the rest. Works with any deal tracker that exports CSV.

→ deals_2026-04-15.csv · 1,244 rows → detected: rep, install date, tier, address, MRC → 11 reps matched · 0 unmapped · ready

### Every rep on the right rate.

Fiber, solar, alarms, pest. Veterans, ramp reps, team leads — everyone on what they earn. Raise rates without rewriting history.

Fiber 500$120.00 Fiber 1G$175.00 Fiber 2G$265.00

### Churn-aware commission reclaim.

We catch churn even when the carrier's report doesn't match your CRM exactly. Reclaim posts on the next statement — no awkward DMs.

Match rate on churned addresses this quarter

### Hold back. Release on time.

Protect margin during the clawback window. Release on schedule when the deal's safe. Reps see exactly what's pending and when it lands.

### Reps see their own ledger.

Every rep logs in and sees what they earned, what's held, and what lands next. Ops stops being the middleman.

Generate, sign, and email statements in one click. Keep a clean audit trail for every cycle.

## Door Knocker. The field app that feeds the ledger.

Import leads, generate territories, assign reps, and track every knock from the field. Door Knocker streams core canvassing activity into D2DHQ — no CSV imports, no end-of-week reconciliation, no "I swear I knocked that house."

Core canvassing is included in every plan. AI coaching and household intelligence stay disabled until they are enabled for your organization.

Still cheaper than one missed clawback. A single commission analyst costs $79k–$84k/yr loaded — that's $6,200–$6,900/mo before they miss a single clawback. And they will: 80% of companies admit paying reps wrong, the industry error rate is ~3%, and on a $200k monthly commission spend that's $6,000/mo walking out the door. Worse — 9% of reps quit over comp disputes. Replacing one rep costs 50–200% of their annual earnings. You're not choosing between D2DHQ and a spreadsheet. You're choosing between a predictable monthly plan and the next clawback you don't catch.

No contracts. Cancel anytime. Sign up on your own, pay the $500 setup fee, and we start onboarding your account.

Core Door Knocker canvassing is included. AI add-ons include unlimited reps and one pooled company balance; AI Coach and household intelligence remain in controlled release until enabled for your account.

## Answers before you sign up.

The questions D2D operators actually ask before paying the setup fee — pricing, QuickBooks, clawbacks, the Door Knocker app, and how fast you can get live.

What is D2DHQ?

D2DHQ is commission operations and canvassing software for door-to-door sales teams. It handles commission calculations, clawbacks, escrow, signed rep statements, QuickBooks-ready runs, territory assignment, lead routes, and knock tracking for fiber, solar, pest, alarms, roofing, and other field-sales businesses.

How is D2DHQ priced?

D2DHQ uses flat monthly plans based on settled deal volume: Starter is $149/mo for up to 150 deals, Pro is $299/mo for up to 300, and Elite is $499/mo for up to 600. Overage is $1.50 per additional settled deal. There are no per-rep fees. A one-time $500 onboarding fee starts account setup and covers rate card migration, historical import, QuickBooks setup, train
